decisions.reason: The same-message FAQ introduction already represents the on-chain referral-milestone badge copy; no separate cross-Requirement transition is necessary.
The award-condition update does not change the current badge icon, naming, or presentation choices, and it does not explicitly cancel the First Referral badge.
Badge award milestones do not change the mint-number basis, lifetime, sharing, display, or resale behavior of referral codes.
The candidate already requires permanent badges to be visible in NFT metadata; the new award milestones do not invalidate or alter that metadata requirement.
Badge award conditions do not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or earning limit.
Referral-milestone badge awards are independent of VRF-based prize-winner selection.
Changing when badges are awarded does not change the existing rule that earned badges transfer with the NFT on resale.
Badge award milestones do not alter mint pricing or primary-sale revenue allocation.
Badge milestone rules do not change Big Block prize amounts, draw triggers, ticket handling, or pool funding.
Badge milestone rules do not change Small Block prize amounts, draw intervals, ticket handling, or pool funding.
Badge awards are independent of the winners-page one-click prize claim flow.
Badge award milestones do not alter whether secondary royalties are enforced or their flat amount.
